description: This file defines the PerformanceTrackerLog entity class, which is mapped to the 'ohrm_performance_tracker_log' database table. It includes properties for log details, comments, status, achievement, timestamps, and relationships to other entities such as PerformanceTracker, Employee, and User. The class contains getter and setter methods for each property, facilitating ORM operations and entity management in a PHP project using Doctrine ORM.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLog
classes.description: Entity class representing a log entry for performance tracking, including details such as log message, comments, achievement status, timestamps, and relationships to other entities like PerformanceTracker, Employee, and User.
